describe: A move: a named strike in metres, radians and seconds (the swing's arc, height and reach, what strikes, the body motion, the phase times and the hit window), with a unit test that plays it on a timeline and measures its reach on a humanoid (PLAN.md WP 6.1).
id: the module's path, labs/<lab>/moves/<name> (its id is move:<name>): labs/box/moves/lunge
